evidence.why: Complete input, vector transformation, state-entry, alignment, timer and feedback pipeline.

facts.rationale: Corrects the existing description of x/y as horizontal components and preserves the actual non-wall catch-all branch.
facts.value: Receives a fighter object, requested motion state, surface normal, and contact offset. It computes an impact position and effect angle, copies self velocity, adds knockback x/y, mirrors the vector using the normal, and multiplies its x and y components by common rebound factor x1BC. It stores the resulting vector as knockback, clears all self-velocity components, and derives facing from horizontal knockback. It enters the requested state, applies horizontal alignment for FlyReflectWall or vertical alignment otherwise, initializes damage.x18 from x1C0, delegates feedback using x1B8, and supplies planar post-rebound speed multiplied by fighter weight to the impact-audio routine.

evidence.why: Nonzero decrement, unconditional delegation, and selective zero-gated collision checks.

facts.rationale: Replaces the unsupported positive/saturating interpretation with exact guard semantics and preserves the exceptional ungated collision branches.
facts.value: Each invocation decrements damage.x18 by one if it is nonzero, then unconditionally calls ftCo_DamageFly_Anim. A zero value is not decremented locally. In the FlyReflectWall collision branch, zero permits the selected wall-tech and further rebound checks behind the timer guard; earlier ceiling checks and the non-wall collision branch are not gated by this timer. The callback itself tests nonzero, not positivity, and does not establish a general saturation rule for other numeric states or subsequent delegated processing.

evidence.why: The complete function checks ceiling eligibility, initializes FlyReflectCeil, records the surface, and returns whether handled.

facts.rationale: Adds a useful descriptive name for the ceiling-only check-and-enter predicate, consistent with the retained CheckWall hypothesis and canonical FlyReflectCeil state spelling. This is not a claim to recover the original symbol.
